name: Disable Samsung TV Plus
description: Turns off 'Autorun Samsung TV Plus' (db/menu/autorun_tv_plus), clears the boot-into-TV-Plus flag, masks the TV Plus backend (bms-service, slive-provider-daemon, slive-util) and reaps the standalone TV Plus app via a supervised 30s watchdog. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: Clément Péron
